body:
## Summary

Implementation follow-on for the note→board sharing model decision recorded on issue #5830 (decision record: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5830#issuecomment-6719439492), under parent design issue #5677 and programme epic #2056. Filed so the recorded decision has a named implementation next action; implementation timing is a separate decision, per issue #5830's filing note.

## Scope (from the decision record's invariants)

1. Board posts store a note **reference** (object id, home server, pinned version id + content hash, sharer attribution) — never note content as the post's own content.
2. Embed rendering offers both views — live head (default) and as-posted pinned — with a "changed since posted" indicator whenever they differ; a poster/board may pin the default view.
3. Reply anchoring: anchors name a note version + passage selector (section id + text-range/quote-hash) and resolve as exact / relocated / orphaned against newer versions; orphaned replies display against the pinned view and are never silently re-pointed or deleted.
4. Reference edges (`post —embeds→ note`, `reply —anchors→ note-version/passage`, `post —discusses→ note`) live in ID's native graph; backlinks are a query over the same edge store; jump-through works both ways with human/CLI/API/agent parity.
5. Cross-server: resolution is grant-checked against a selective sharing grant and hash-verified; board-side caches are render-only, version-labelled, and honour visibility revocation on refresh; backlink registration is announce-and-ack with retry, and a failed announcement never blocks posting.
6. Share/reply/anchor events are attributed and land in the objects' changelogs; sharing grants no edit rights and creates no fork.

## Out of scope

Anything parent issue #5677 reserves to its other decomposition designs (graph navigation API surface, multiplayer sessions, approval flow mechanics, personalized ranking) and the takedown/erasure reconciliation named in #5677's non-goals.

## Acceptance

- An end-to-end slice: share a note into a board, reply anchored to a passage, edit the note, and observe the live/pinned views, the anchor state transition, and the backlink from the note — locally, and in a two-server setup exercising grant-checked fetch and announce-and-ack backlink registration.

## Acceptance criteria

- An end-to-end slice works: share a note into a board, reply anchored to a passage, edit the note, and observe the live/pinned views, the anchor state transition (exact / relocated / orphaned), and the backlink — as the decision record's invariants require.
- Board posts store a note reference (object id, home server, pinned version id + content hash, sharer attribution) — never note content as the post's own content.
- Orphaned replies display against the pinned view and are never silently re-pointed or deleted.
- Cross-server resolution is grant-checked and hash-verified; board-side caches are render-only, version-labelled, and honour visibility revocation on refresh; a failed backlink announcement never blocks posting.
- Sharing grants no edit rights and creates no fork; share/reply/anchor events are attributed in the objects' changelogs.
